name: Spiritskull
look: a floating translucent crystal skull full of glowing violet-and-amber liquor with vapour leaking from its eyes
entry: Legend says Spiritskull forms inside abandoned bottles left on sunken ships. Those who drink from it experience vivid memories that aren't their own.
how: Wild: rare, at night, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
